raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.4.2"
  build_number: 0

recipe:
  name: pytetwild
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pytetwild/pytetwild-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 60b88a5c9d0fd3cba24b3ab677b6a8344161de958622ce301bd3913fc1f4b917
    patches:
      # Make the top-level ``import pyvista`` in the accessor optional so the core package imports
      # without PyVista, matching the documented "no-op when unsupported" behaviour.
      # PyVista comes with the pytetwild-all output.
      - 0002-optional-pyvista-import.patch
  # geogram, libigl and libigl-predicates are not packaged on conda-forge. They are vendored here
  # rather than left to CMake FetchContent so that the build needs no network access and every
  # revision is pinned by checksum. devendor_dependencies.cmake points FetchContent at them.
  # The geogram release asset is used because the GitHub source archive ships empty submodule
  # directories, and its rply, libMeshb and amgcl submodules are needed to build the library.
  - url: https://github.com/BrunoLevy/geogram/releases/download/v1.9.6/geogram_1.9.6.tar.gz
    sha256: 79dbe919737d8988668d6a72196a82389e0dfd8760250d26a28414afd558477f
    target_directory: vendored/geogram
  - url: https://github.com/libigl/libigl/archive/refs/tags/v2.6.0.tar.gz
    sha256: fe3bf58571cccbef774947261284ccf6b7fdf04fcab5f7181e31931e42a0b14f
    target_directory: vendored/libigl
  # libigl pins libigl-predicates by commit, so there is no tag to track here.
  - url: https://github.com/libigl/libigl-predicates/archive/decb7bc1260e689cbe008109e3cc5d3a5a433aea.tar.gz
    sha256: fd6ff88eff602ea8a600ddd22057e19d876f1f1a9bf9c119a3ecfef1753c5e92
    target_directory: vendored/predicates

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  # Compiled core: the nanobind wrapper around fTetWild plus the pure Python package.
  # This carries only the mandatory ``numpy`` runtime dependency, mirroring ``pip install pytetwild``.
  - package:
      name: pytetwild
    build:
      script:
        env:
          # The sdist ships no git history, so pin the version for setuptools-scm.
          SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ version }}
          # Use the Ninja generator on Unix.
          # On Windows keep the Visual Studio generator selected by the conda-forge activation, so
          # CMake picks up the MSVC toolchain instead of failing to find a compiler under Ninja.
          CMAKE_GENERATOR: ${{ "Ninja" if unix else "Visual Studio 17 2022" }}
        content:
          # devendor_dependencies.cmake resolves fmt, spdlog, TBB, nlohmann_json and Eigen from
          # conda-forge, points FetchContent at the vendored sources, and fails on any upstream
          # dependency it does not know about.
          # CMP0170 must come from the command line, since the top level include runs too late to
          # affect the policy of the top level project. Without it, a FetchContent_Populate() with
          # no source directory is only a warning and the build fails later on a missing header.
          - >-
            python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
            --config-settings=cmake.define.CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0170=NEW
            --config-settings=cmake.define.CMAKE_PROJECT_TOP_LEVEL_INCLUDES=${{ "$RECIPE_DIR" if unix else "%RECIPE_DIR%" }}/devendor_dependencies.cmake
            --config-settings=cmake.define.FLOAT_TETWILD_ENABLE_TBB=ON
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - scikit-build-core >=0.10
        - nanobind >=1.3.2
        - setuptools-scm >=8
        # De-vendored native dependencies provided by conda-forge, wired in by the injected
        # devendor_dependencies.cmake file.
        # The remaining fTetWild dependencies (geogram, libigl, libigl-predicates) are vendored by
        # the recipe sources above.
        # Eigen is only a header-only build-time dependency compiled into the extension, so per the
        # eigen-feedstock guidance a plain eigen host dependency (case A) with no ABI marker is enough.
        # It is capped below 5 because the vendored libigl 2.6.0 does not build against the reorganized Eigen 5 headers.
        - eigen <5
        - fmt
        - gmp
        - nlohmann_json
        - spdlog
        - tbb-devel
      run:
        - python
        - numpy
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - pytetwild
          pip_check: true
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - pytetwild/PyfTetWildWrapper*

  - package:
      name: pytetwild-all
    build:
      # Empty metapackage with no Python content of its own; the interpreter
      # constraint comes transitively from the pytetwild run dependency.
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        # Version pin rather than an exact build, so this metapackage stays noarch while tracking
        # the pytetwild it was built alongside.
        # pytetwild carries the python constraint.
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('pytetwild', lower_bound='x.x.x', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - pyvista
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - pytetwild
          pip_check: true
      # Run the upstream test suite here, where PyVista is available so the PyVista-based tests
      # exercise the full package.
      # The tests are not shipped inside the package, so they are taken from the source tree.
      # The download_bunny_coarse cases are skipped as they require network.
      - script:
          - pytest -v -k "not download_bunny_coarse" tests
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
            - meshio
            - scipy <1.17.0
        files:
          source:
            - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/pyvista/pytetwild
  summary: Python wrapper of fTetWild for mesh tetrahedralization
  description: pytetwild is a Python library for mesh tetrahedralization. It is a Python wrapper around the efficient C++ library for tetrahedral meshing provided by fTetWild.
  license: MPL-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND LicenseRef-Public-Domain
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - src/fTetWild/LICENSE.MPL2
    # Vendored dependencies linked into the extension. Only the MPL2 part of libigl is used, since
    # fTetWild links igl::core and igl::predicates and never the igl_copyleft targets.
    - vendored/geogram/LICENSE
    - vendored/libigl/LICENSE.MPL2
    # Shewchuk's predicates carry their public domain dedication in the README.
    - vendored/predicates/README.md
  repository: https://github.com/pyvista/pytetwild

extra:
  feedstock-name: pytetwild
  recipe-maintainers:
    - diegoferigo
